question: If the cost price of 30 chairs is equal to the selling price of 40 chairs, find the loss percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: 30 × CP = 40 × SP

Ratio of CP to SP ⇒ CP : SP = 40 : 30 = 4 : 3

Loss = CP − SP = 4 − 3 = 1 unit

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100 = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**
